normalSyntheticFixture.sourceProvenance: Deterministic synthetic stereo tones, decaying kicks and silence. Intentional single-sample overloads are disabled. No recorded music or live input.
normalSyntheticFixture.steadyTimerIntervalLimit: Excludes startup through 0.4 s and the interval immediately following a capture or layout change; still a GUI-thread fixture, not DAW performance.
normalSyntheticFixture.captureMethod: Real JUCE editor component snapshots at 1x logical size; validates raster waveform and UI. The Studio OpenGL child is not captured by this method.
normalSyntheticFixture.styleComparison: After input stops, frozen Silk/Prism/Trace use identical samples, window, dimensions, palette and gain. Interior hashes exclude controls, titles, axes and levels. Repeated Prism/Trace captures must match, and returning to Silk must restore its interior exactly.
normalSyntheticFixture.axisVerification: Zoom screenshots include the painted amplitude axis; expectedAmplitudeAxisLimit records 1, 0.5 or 0.25 for visual review. No OCR or numeric inference from pixels is performed.
normalSyntheticFixture.timingLimit: Developer GUI-thread feed and PNG captures affect timer intervals; these are QA observations, not real-time audio or DAW performance measurements.
normalSyntheticFixture.deliveryClock: Prefill + floor(monotonic elapsed seconds * 48000), completed exactly in blocks of at most 800 samples until the explicit input stop.

originalProceduralMusicMotion.sourceProvenance: Original deterministic procedural music: eight 4/4 bars at 80 BPM, with pitch-swept kick, snare, hats, syncopated bass, detuned stereo chords, arpeggio and a silent breakdown. Smoothly bounded below 0.92 absolute amplitude; no deliberate clipping or isolated impulses. No recording, external composition or live input; no audio output.
originalProceduralMusicMotion.captureMethod: Real native JUCE component snapshots cropped to the full waveform panel, including its controls and axes, at 1x logical size. Up to 120 images are buffered and PNG-encoded only after recording stops.
originalProceduralMusicMotion.encoding: frames.ffconcat uses actual capture intervals, with the final file repeated to apply its duration. Numbered PNGs alone imply 30 fps and may distort timing if missedNominalFrameSlots is nonzero. No frames are synthesized.
originalProceduralMusicMotion.timingLimit: Native GUI-thread QA capture; snapshot work can affect timer and paint timing. This is not a real-time DAW performance benchmark.

limitations: Native QA fixtures are synthetic PCM, not recorded music or an Ableton playback session.
Reported GUI/capture timings are development-harness observations, not guaranteed DAW frame rates.
Occupancy shading is normalized visual density; filtered-band contours are not isolated band waveforms.
